$comment: Snapshot of the organised page, read back over REST after the reorganisation, in layers-panel (reading) order. Flow IDs are scoped to the ROLE code (ACCESS, NGO, OFFICER, DIRECTOR, PMU), not to the lane, so a role column can be split or regrouped without renumbering. A retired ID is never reused. Regenerate after any structural change.
